title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 17.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 17.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 could allow an authenticated user with a valid agent token to cause a denial of service in the GitLab agent server (KAS) due to improper input validation. This issue has been remediated by GitLab.
